name: 케른
face: 입 대신 커다란 톱니 구멍이 있는 얼굴
outfit: 탄환을 흡수하기 위해 열린 흉부 장갑
silhouette: 커다란 톱니 모양 입, 전선 꼬리, 드릴 형태의 무기, 둥근 몸체
signature_motion: 탄환이 다가오면 몸의 틈새가 벌어지며 빛을 내뿜음
signature_vfx: 에메랄드빛 소용돌이 에너지가 입으로 빨려 들어가는 효과
visual_en: A small 2-head tall metallic creature facing right. It has a large, dark grey circular body with a prominent emerald green glowing core at the center. The head features a massive, jagged gear-shaped mouth lined with sharp metallic teeth. A single, bright emerald lens eye glows intensely. From its rear, a thick bundle of dark grey electric wires serves as a tail. The creature holds a large, rotating drill-shaped weapon that emits a soft green light. Its limbs are heavy, dark steel pincers. Ornate emerald energy flows through the gaps in its oxidized copper armor, creating a striking contrast against its dark metallic frame.
pose_en: Hungrily lunging towards an incoming projectile with an open maw.
vfx_en: Swirling emerald light particles being sucked into the center of the body.
motion_en: Expanding chest plates to absorb damage
lore: 탄을 먹는다. 탄 피해를 절반쯤만 받고 그만큼 회복한다.

anim_notes.hit: swallowing an incoming bullet with its mouth wide open
